title: infra: a missing DEVBIN_INFRA_PROFILE is silently passed over, profiles never validates, and three smaller defects
body:
FOUND 2026-09-23 while 0113's consumer page for infra was checked against the code. Each point was read by cc at 142763d. They are small, and they are grouped because they share a subsystem and an owner.

1. `$DEVBIN_INFRA_PROFILE` NAMING A MISSING FILE IS SILENTLY PASSED OVER (lib/infra, infra_resolve_profile). The code is `[ -n "$DEVBIN_INFRA_PROFILE" ] && [ -f "$DEVBIN_INFRA_PROFILE" ]`, and a miss falls through to `<project root>/infra.yaml` and then `~/.config/devbin/infra.yaml`. So a typo in the variable runs `check` against a different profile, and nothing says so. An explicit `--profile` naming a missing file is refused by name two lines above. The same caller intent -- "this file" -- gets two different answers depending on how it was spelled.
2. `infra profiles` SAYS IT VALIDATES AND DOES NOT (lib/cmd/infra.d/profiles). Its usage reads "Validate every infra.yaml under <dir>". The loop only loads each file and extracts its domain pairs; infra_validate_profile is never called, so a profile `show` and `check` would refuse passes here.
3. THE `(unnamed)` FALLBACK CANNOT FIRE (lib/cmd/infra, show and check). `cfg_get name 2>/dev/null || printf '(unnamed)'` -- cfg_get prints its default and returns 0 when the key is absent (lib/config), so a profile with no `name:` prints an empty name. lib/infra.reference.yaml promises "(unnamed)".
4. `infra mail dmarc --help` NAMES A VERB THAT DOES NOT EXIST. It points at `infra mail dmarc check`, and the dispatch has only `parse` and `report`.
5. TWO LABELS AND A PATH. The check report says "Fly runtime is WP-07", while lib/infra.reference.yaml calls the same leg ST0006. And `infra --help` hard-codes `bin/.devbin/lib/infra.reference.yaml`, which is wrong in devbin's own checkout. That is the shape 0112 fixed for `devbin devbin` with lib_rel.

## Resolution

Fixed at 2b9d1a5. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. (1) A $DEVBIN_INFRA_PROFILE naming a missing file is refused on that file, as --profile always was, where it fell through to <project root>/infra.yaml. (2) infra profiles validates each profile as show does, printing what validation says under the file it is about, with the load's own reason. (3) A profile with no name: shows and reports as (unnamed). (4) infra mail dmarc --help calls check planned (devbin's ST0006). (5) The check report's Fly label says devbin's ST0006, and infra --help names the reference at $(lib_rel), which moves into lib/helpers. infra.md changes with 1 and 2.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. 10 new arms and 1 changed. On 0126's tree 9 of those 11 are red, and the two green there are green by construction: the install-side path arm and a positive control. M1-M12 are killed, each by the arm aimed at it, and cc's P1-P12 are all killed.
- REVIEW. cc: approved.
- THE SUITE. The full suite on the series as it landed -- land018 at c130b3a, whose 27 series paths are byte-identical to the landed commits: 1..1653, 1653 ok, 0 not ok, 4 skips (127, 135, 624, 626), rc 0, 12:39:28Z to 13:11:35Z. Each commit passed the gate (guards, critic, doctor) as it landed.
